summary: This informational memo gives proposed registration and administration procedures for Chinese domain names. Many common Chinese characters have variants, so most names have at least two forms, and equivalence between Simplified and Traditional Chinese is key. It builds on RFC 3743 and explains the IANA tables.

eli5.summary: Some Chinese characters can be written in more than one way. This explains how a website name can be reserved in all its spellings so nobody steals the twin.

questions: simplified and traditional chinese domain names
